name: prompt-pane
description: Streams current-session prompts and usage metadata to the local Prompt Pane viewer.

interface.shortDescription: Show this session's prompts in a companion pane.
interface.longDescription: Sends Codex lifecycle events to the authenticated local Prompt Pane process. It does not add model context or send prompt content over the network.
defaultPrompt: Help me verify that Prompt Pane is connected to this Codex session.
